changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE `order_dept_receiver` ( `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键ID', `dept_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '部门ID', `dept_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '部门名称', `receiver_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '接收人ID', `receiver_name` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '接收人姓名', `create_time` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间', `update_time` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间', PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_dept_id` (`dept_id`) ) ENGINE = InnoDB COMMENT = '部门工单接收人配置表';
